content: You can now build and test applications using Azure SQL Database container, which runs the same Azure SQL Database engine locally that you run in the cloud. It’s free for local dev and CI, with no Azure subscription or credit card required. This cross-platform developer experience supports both x64 and ARM and integrates with Visual Studio Code, SSMS, Docker, native container hosts, and dev containers for a simple, consistent development workflow. ARM support for full text, poly base, and extensibility in Azure SQL Database container will come soon. Learn more.
